name: Hotel Mount Olympus
detailed_description:
Meet your Coworkers


About the Game

A rigid hotel owner, a hot-headed chef, a stone-cold security guard, and much much more. Clock in, to your new role as a relationship adviser where you’ll build and manage connections—in this one of a kind visual novel. 

Choose your path for how you’ll walk amongst the Gods, unlock hidden tales among the halls of Mount Olympus, and get into all kinds of scandals, even ones that weren't told amongst mortals…What? Gods gotta have their secrets too.

Can you help guide these Olympian Gods through the struggles of love, family dynamic, work-life balance and self purpose? You've got 1 week, let's make it count!

Welcome to Hotel Mount Olympus, where the Gods NEED you.

FEATURES:

  • Hilarious Hi-jinks Dialogue

Quips, shade, and stings that strike like a bolt to the heart. This tongue and cheek modern take of the Gods is a comedy so rich, Gelos gave it an A+--so you know it’s good. A little teasing goes a long way, it might even reach you.

  • A Modern Re-imagining of Greek Mythology

This game offers a fresh modern take on Greek Mythology  with re-imagined personas of thee Olympian Gods. We only ask for you to keep an open mind, leave your preconceived notions behind, and of course have fun!

  • Relationship Manager

One God hates the other, one is harboring a secret and the other is totally just trying to manage, babe. Do you think you can handle it? 

  • Charming Art

Carefully crafted sprites with character that exudes beyond their precisely stroked edges!

  • Full Voice Acting

Packed with amazing talented voice acting with every line of dialogue. Each character beams from the screen to your ears. 

  • LGBTQIA Friendly

Love proceeds all, and for the love among Gods not even mortals can comprehend it. Our game is 1000% LGBTQIA friendly and inclusive.  

  • Multiple Endings

Select your choices, or don't— this game doesn't punish you for not working but Zeus might. With multiple endings, let's see if you can make it through the week.

MATURE CONTENT DESCRIPTION:

Hotel Mount Olympus features mature themes, sexual/suggestive topics, naughty words, and touches on suicidal thoughts and self-image.

short_description: Hotel Mount Olympus is filled with heart, love and well-meaning faux pas’. Spend a week building connections between the gods, restoring once-shattered ones, and helping new ones blossom. Welcome to our quirky, and vibrant hotel, where the Gods NEED you.

  • Processor: Anything from the last 5 years
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: No
